option_relations.rationale: Dominant dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa is a broader category that can include Epidermolysis Bullosa Pruriginosa as a subtype, although EBP is more commonly associated with recessive forms.
Dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa is a broader category, and Epidermolysis Bullosa Pruriginosa is a specific clinical variant of Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa.
Epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa (EBP) is directly equivalent to the leaf Epidermolysis Bullosa Pruriginosa.
Recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa is a broader category that includes Epidermolysis Bullosa Pruriginosa as a specific clinical variant.
